tools.name: blossoms_get_api_catalog
tools.description: Fetch the Cherry Blossoms API catalog for agent service discovery.

tools.name: blossoms_get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a same-origin Cherry Blossoms page as markdown when the server can negotiate it.

path.description: Same-origin path or URL to retrieve as markdown.

tools.name: blossoms_list_destination_members
tools.description: List public member previews for a destination country and optional city.

country.description: Destination country slug, for example philippines.

limit.description: Maximum number of member previews to return.

tools.name: blossoms_open_signup
tools.description: Navigate the browser to the Cherry Blossoms signup flow, optionally preselecting male or female.
